title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
source: (no source info given- listeners report AUD)

ai_review.summary: A legendary June‑24‑1970 show with scorching Alligator > Other One jams and rare Attics runs, captured on a rough audience tape.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the performance – multiple Attics renditions, an incendiary Alligator > Other One sequence, a sweet second Dark Star and standout early cuts of Cold Rain & Snow and Good Lovin' > China > Rider.  The recording is an audience capture with noticeable muddiness, drop‑outs and limited fidelity, but listeners accept the trade‑off for the historic set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give high marks (5 stars) for the show itself; only a few note poor sound quality, yielding an overall weighted average around 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is not great – muffled, occasional drop‑outs and low fidelity; reviewers call it a 1‑star SQ or “not great” but still valuable for the missing material.

standout_songs: Good Lovin' > China > Rider > Good Lovin'
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set praised for its energy; the band weaves in and out of jams, delivering a powerful second half with multiple Attics reprises and a standout Alligator jam that ties the two shows together.
